title: Understanding Model Complexity
text: When you reduce the number of features in a model, what happens to the model's complexity?

title: Training Error vs. Validation Error
text: Consider how training error and validation error are affected by model complexity. What does an increase in training error and a decrease in validation error suggest?

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: Think about the bias-variance tradeoff. How does reducing the number of features affect bias and variance?

title: Analyzing the Effect of Feature Reduction
text: Reducing the number of features from $$29$$ to $$10$$ decreases the model's complexity. This typically increases bias but decreases variance. The increase in training error suggests higher bias, while the decrease in validation error suggests lower variance.
